statement.description: Once Bob got to a sale of old TV sets. There were $ n $ TV sets at that sale. TV set with index $ i $ costs $ a_{i} $ bellars. Some TV sets have a negative price — their owners are ready to pay Bob if he buys their useless apparatus. Bob can «buy» any TV sets he wants. Though he's very strong, Bob can carry at most $ m $ TV sets, and he has no desire to go to the sale for the second time. Please, help Bob find out the maximum sum of money that he can earn.
statement.formatI: The first line contains two space-separated integers $ n $ and $ m $ ( $ 1<=m<=n<=100 $ ) — amount of TV sets at the sale, and amount of TV sets that Bob can carry. The following line contains $ n $ space-separated integers $ a_{i} $ ( $ -1000<=a_{i}<=1000 $ ) — prices of the TV sets.
statement.formatO: Output the only number — the maximum sum of money that Bob can earn, given that he can carry at most $ m $ TV sets.

translation.description: 有一天，Bob 去参加了一场旧电视机的拍卖会。这场拍卖会上共有 $n$ 台电视机，第 $i$ 台电视机的价格为 $a_{i}$ 贝拉尔。有些电视机的价格是负数——也就是说，如果 Bob 购买这些无用的电视机，卖家还会倒贴钱给他。Bob 可以「购买」任意多的电视机。不过，尽管他力气很大，最多也只能搬走 $m$ 台电视机，并且他不打算第二次去拍卖会。请你帮助 Bob 计算，他最多能赚到多少钱。
translation.formatI:
第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $n$ 与 $m$（$1 \leq m \leq n \leq 100$），分别表示拍卖会上的电视机数量，以及 Bob 最多能带走的电视机数量。  
第二行包含 $n$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $a_{i}$（$-1000 \leq a_{i} \leq 1000$），表示每台电视机的价格。
translation.formatO: 输出一个整数，表示在最多携带 $m$ 台电视机的前提下，Bob 能获得的最大盈利金额。
